messages:
maya: Quick design review — wireframe for inline action cues in Schema Editor attached. Goal: make tool-calling and function-def actions discoverable in compact run history and editor gutter.
liam: sgtm, can you paste the mock? :eyes: 
maya: Paste below — simple overlay affordance, small action pill shows "Run with tool" and kebab opens function def. Example copy: "Invoke tool: Summarize" vs just "Summarize". Thoughts?
sasha: Inline pill helps scanning. Concern: keyboard focus order. If it's decorative we need aria-hidden, but if actionable must be focusable.
maya: Agree. Proposal in mock: use button role, tabindex=0, aria-label="Invoke tool Summarize". Also visible focus ring and high-contrast border.
liam: Do we need a confirmation step? Some tools call external APIs.
maya: For side-effectful tools: show a secondary "Confirm" in the run modal. Inline pill is quick-preview only.
sasha: Accessibility nit: color + icon contrast fails for orange on white at 12px. Use 16px and darker color.
maya: Updated specs: 16px, #1f2937 icon color, focus outline 3px, and label text becomes "Invoke" on hover with tooltip. Also screen-reader friendly: announce "Tool invocation available" when focused.
liam: Small UX ask: can we add a hover affordance in run history rows to show same pill? Many users scan history to re-run with altered args.
maya: Yes — plan: shared component used in editor gutter and run history. States: default, hover, focused, disabled (when incompatible).
sasha: One more: keyboard shortcut to open tool def: Shift+K? Might conflict. Suggest Cmd+Shift+I.
liam: Ok. I'll prototype in playground. I'll also add a feature flag so we can test in beta orgs.
maya: Awesome. @dev-bot can you create a PR checklist? :white_check_mark:
dev-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playground/pull/512 — includes an a11y checklist, tests, and storybook.
liam: Thanks — tagging UX research to run quick hallway tests.
maya: Thanks all, will update figma and post final assets tomorrow.
